about: Alternate tunings for OS 1.7.3+0: writes the firmware's note table (0x848c5270, 128 words) from tunings built on the unit from its own stock table, only when a run-time CRC-32 says that table is the stock one. Shift and the metronome key open its page: the blue knob picks a group, the second knob a tuning in it (12 equal, built-ins, .oft files of its folder `tuning` named group-name.oft), the third the root, the fourth a detune of -50..+50 cents. The choice is kept in its hidden folder `tuning-set`. Card level 3, no table entries.
name: tuning
